list_tables.title: List tables and fields
list_tables.description: List a knowledge base's tables with their logical names, and each table's fields with name, label, type and required flag -- or one table only. Start here to learn the names every other tool takes.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

table.description: Only this table's logical name, instead of every table.

include_linked_info.description: True to include the source table and column of linked fields.

skip_columns_info.description: True to return tables only, without their fields.

list_saved_searches.title: List saved searches
list_saved_searches.description: List the saved searches defined for a table with their label, name, id and description, for use with run_saved_search.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

search_records.title: Search records
search_records.description: Find records in a table with an ad hoc query -- field='value', ~= for contains, !=, <, <=, >, >=, joined with && or || -- and return the fields you list.

query.description: Ad hoc query, e.g. summary~='test'&&priority=3. Quote values; quote field labels that contain spaces.

fields.description: Logical field names to return, e.g. ["id", "summary"].

output.description: The matching records with the requested fields.

run_saved_search.title: Run a saved search
run_saved_search.description: Run a saved search on a table, optionally narrowed by an extra query, a page at a time. Without field, each result carries its id, type and ownership fields.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

search.description: Label of the saved search to run, e.g. C: Status is Closed.

query.description: Extra ad hoc condition applied on top, e.g. priority=High.

field.description: One logical field name to include in each result, besides id and ownership fields.

output.description: The count and the records on this page.

select_record_ids.title: Select record ids by SQL
select_record_ids.description: Return the ids of the records matching an SQL where clause written with database column names (from the Table Wizard). Choice values must be their internal ids -- see get_choice_line_id. Security filters still apply.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

where.description: SQL where clause on database column names, e.g. assigned_person='Ralph Knowles' or summary like '%new%'.

output.description: The number of ids and the ids.

read_record.title: Read a record
read_record.description: Read every field of one record, by id or by an SQL condition that matches exactly one record.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

id.description: Record id; or identify the record with search_sql.

search_sql.description: SQL condition matching exactly one record, e.g. ext_id='a0B2c345', instead of id.

create_record.title: Create a record
create_record.description: Create a record in a table from logical field values, including linked fields by query by example. Rules and workflows on the table run as they would in the UI.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

fields.description: Record field values keyed by logical field name, e.g. {"contract_title": "MSA", "company_name": ":Acme"}. Choice fields take their text; linked fields take :value query-by-example strings.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

update_record.title: Update a record
update_record.description: Change the given fields of one record, identified by id or an SQL condition matching exactly one record. Only the fields sent change.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

fields.description: Record field values keyed by logical field name, e.g. {"contract_title": "MSA", "company_name": ":Acme"}. Choice fields take their text; linked fields take :value query-by-example strings.

id.description: Record id; or identify the record with search_sql.

search_sql.description: SQL condition matching exactly one record, instead of id.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

operation_hints.description: NOLOCK to update even if the record is locked.

upsert_record.title: Create or update a record
upsert_record.description: Update the one record matching a query, or create it when none matches -- the way to sync from another system on a unique external id. Several matches is an error.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

match_query.description: Condition matching the record to update, e.g. external_id='SF-001234'; combine fields with &&.

fields.description: Record field values keyed by logical field name, e.g. {"contract_title": "MSA", "company_name": ":Acme"}. Choice fields take their text; linked fields take :value query-by-example strings.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

output.description: The id of the created or updated record.

delete_record.title: Delete a record
delete_record.description: Delete a record, choosing what happens to records that depend on it: fail, delete them, unlink them, or relink them to a replacement. If any record cannot be deleted, none is.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

subs.description: Replacement record id, required with REPLACE_WITH_ANOTHER.

get_record_lock.title: Get a record's lock
get_record_lock.description: Check whether a record is locked, by whom, and how many minutes the lock has left.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

output.description: id, table_id, locked_by, lock_status and lock_expires_in_minutes.

lock_record.title: Lock a record
lock_record.description: Lock a record so others cannot edit it; the lock expires after the lock_expiration_time global variable.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

unlock_record.title: Unlock a record
unlock_record.description: Release a record's lock; admins can force-release another user's lock.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

force.description: True to unlock a record another user locked; admins only.

get_attachment_info.title: Get attachment info
get_attachment_info.description: List the files in a record's file field with their position, name and size.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

field.description: Logical name of the file field.

retrieve_attachment.title: Download an attachment
retrieve_attachment.description: Download one file from a record's file field by its position. The response body is the file itself, in its original content type.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

field.description: Logical name of the file field.

file_position.description: Position of the file in the field, from 0 (see get_attachment_info).

remove_attachment.title: Remove an attachment
remove_attachment.description: Remove one file from a record's file field by its position.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

field.description: Logical name of the file field.

file_position.description: Position of the file in the field, from 0.

output.description: The number of files left in the field.

run_action_button.title: Run an action button
run_action_button.description: Run an action button field on a record asynchronously, triggering whatever actions it is configured with. Poll get_async_status with the returned callback id.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

name.description: Logical name of the action button field.

output.description: The record id and callback id.

get_async_status.title: Get an async call's status
get_async_status.description: Check an asynchronous call: HTTP 200 done, 201 queued, 202 running, 501 failed, 523 unknown callback id.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

callback_id.description: Callback id returned by an asynchronous call.

output.description: The status, conveyed by the HTTP code.

get_choice_line_id.title: Get a choice value's id
get_choice_line_id.description: Translate a choice field's text value into the internal id SQL where clauses need. Ids change when a KB is copied or its choice list is recreated, so look them up at run time.

table.description: Logical table name, case sensitive, e.g. contract or contacts.employees.

lang.description: Two-letter language code used to resolve names (default en).

field.description: Logical name of the choice field.
